name: VanillaTweaks Crafting Tweaks (vanilla recipe overrides)
summary: The part of the VanillaTweaks Crafting Tweaks datapack that lives in the minecraft namespace. It overrides vanilla stair, trapdoor, wood/hyphae and brick recipes to give more output per craft, and adds extra recipes for slabs, black dye, bread, paper and shulker boxes.

mechanics.title: Block <-> slab <-> stair conversion
mechanics.description: Together with the Back to Blocks module, slabs and stairs can go both ways: 1 block -> 2 slabs (shapeless), 2 slabs -> 1 block, 6 blocks -> 8 stairs, 4 stairs -> 3 blocks.

vanilla_changes.what: Stairs (about 57 types: all wood planks incl. bamboo and bamboo mosaic, stone, cobblestone, mossy, stone/deepslate/tuff/blackstone variants, bricks of all kinds, prismarine, purpur, quartz, smooth quartz, sandstone and red sandstone variants, all cut copper stages incl. waxed)
vanilla_changes.change: Same shaped recipe as vanilla (6 blocks in the stair shape) but now yields 8 stairs instead of 4.

vanilla_changes.what: Wooden trapdoors (oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, pale oak, bamboo, crimson, warped)
vanilla_changes.change: Same 2x3 planks layout (6 planks) but yields 12 trapdoors instead of 2. Iron trapdoor is not changed; copper trapdoor is only regrouped (still 2x2 copper ingots -> 1).

vanilla_changes.what: Wood and hyphae blocks (oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, pale oak wood; crimson and warped hyphae; and their stripped versions)
vanilla_changes.change: Same 2x2 log/stem recipe but yields 4 instead of 3.
Now also accept chiseled and cracked stone bricks (vanilla: only plain stone bricks), in addition to the 8-per-craft change.
Ingredient now only purpur block; vanilla also accepted purpur pillar. This is a minor regression from the vanilla recipe (8 stairs per craft otherwise).

vanilla_changes.what: Slabs (47 non-wood types incl. waxed copper slabs, smooth stone/quartz/sandstone slabs, bamboo mosaic)
vanilla_changes.change: New shapeless recipe: 1 block -> 2 slabs (vanilla gives 6 slabs from 3 blocks in a row, which is still available).
2x2 smooth stone slabs -> 2 smooth stone (extra, in addition to the 2-slabs recipe from Back to Blocks).
Shapeless: 1 coal -> 1 black dye; 1 charcoal -> 1 black dye.
Shapeless: 2 shulker shells + 1 chest (any arrangement) -> 1 shulker box.
Overridden with a recipe group added but identical ingredients/output; no gameplay change.

qol: Shapeless versions of bread, paper and shulker box remove the need to place items in a specific pattern.
getting_started: Nothing to enable: stairs, trapdoors, wood and bricks simply give more per craft. Craft slabs by putting a single block in the crafting grid.
sources: Datapack files in client/overrides/datapacks/vanillatweaks/data/minecraft/recipe/ (145 recipes) compared against vanilla recipes in minecraft-assets/data/minecraft/recipe/
editor_notes: 145 recipe files compared with vanilla: 93 overrides changing counts (stairs 8x, trapdoors 12x (that is the data value; vanilla 2), wood/hyphae 4x, bricks 4x), 2 cosmetic overrides (packed_ice, copper_trapdoor), 47 slab and 3 straight-to-shapeless and 2 dye recipes added. 'Stairs about 57' includes stone and stone-brick stairs; vanilla stair recipes use the pattern shown. Stripped wood/hyphae and bark recipes come from the More Bark tweak; 12 trapdoors per craft (VanillaTweaks More Trapdoors) is large and likely worth verifying in-game. Selected pack list (Selected Packs.txt): unpackable wool/nether wart/ice, craftable blackstone/bundles rabbit hide/coral/gravel, more bricks/stairs/bark/trapdoors, powder to glass, blackstone cobblestone, straight to shapeless, universal/sandstone dyeing, coal/charcoal to black dye, copper powered rails, rotten flesh to leather, dropper to dispenser, double slabs, back to blocks.
